the trading of medicines in most countries is not in the hands of pharmacists and this is a risk to public health and safety.
the trading of medicines should be in the hand of professionals and that the legislations should be revised to ensure that this happens.
there is a need for a global effort to stop the trading of medicines in the hands of non-professionals and non-licensed entities.

the risks of international trading of medicines by non-licensed entities and nonprofessionals.
the risks associated with international trading of medicines by non-licensed entities and nonprofessionals.
the risks that the informal trade of medicines and related products pose to the public.

the trading of medicines in the hand of nonprofessionals and unlicensed entities should be outlawed.
